metadata.title: Climate Change 2022: Impacts, Adaptation and Vulnerability. Chapter 5: Food, Fibre, and Other Ecosystem Products

summary: IPCC AR6 WG2 Chapter 5 assessment on vulnerability of dryland cropping systems to rainfall deficits and heat stress.

sections.text: Rainfed agricultural systems in drylands face accelerating drought frequency. Polyculture rotations, hedgerow windbreaks, and mulching maintain soil humidity, lower surface evaporation by 20-30%, and stabilize yield volatility under rainfall deficits.
Deploying drought-resilient legumes in crop rotations enhances nitrogen availability and dampens pest outbreaks, reducing overall vulnerability to prolonged dry spells.
